name: Government Degree College Lakarai — GDC Lakarai
description: Government Degree College Lakarai, Bajaur Express Road, Mohmand, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. Affiliated with Bacha Khan University, Charsadda. Intermediate (Pre-Engineering, Pre-Medical, ICS, Arts), Associate Degrees (AD English, AD Urdu, AD Political Science) and BS programs (Urdu, Zoology, Botany, Political Science, Computer Science). Established 2004.
